_comment: Short labels for nominating bodies the parliamentary catalogue does not carry. Keys are nameKey() folds of the nominator string as the ballot spells it. DELIBERATELY SPARSE: an entry is somebody asserting that a body trades under a short name, which nothing in this repo can derive — so each is a decision, and the generator reports the candidates rather than filling them in. It never supplies a colour; a short label is a naming convenience and a colour is a brand claim.
